Deliver a plea for help to [[Miller Upton]] before [[Namar]] faces eviction.

== Quest information ==
=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = n
}}

=== Objectives ===
* Follow the road southwest from town to [[Ashford]]. Find Miller Upton and ask him to help Namar.
* Use the [[Massive Honeycomb|honeycomb]] to lure the three [[Swarm of Bees|bee swarms]] across the bridge.
* Return to Miller Upton for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 25 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Divine Symbol (loop)|Divine Symbol]]
** [[Energy]] +3
** [[Health]] -20
** Energy +12 (while Health is below 33%)
** [[Armor rating|Armor]] +10 (while Health is below 33%)

== Walkthrough ==
Head down the southwest road from [[Ascalon City (pre-Searing)|Ascalon City]] to Ashford and speak with Miller Upton. Before he can help Namar, you'll need to handle a bee problem for him. Pick up the Massive Honeycomb and approach the three bee swarms to grab their attention. Lead the swarms across the bridge until the quest updates, drop the honeycomb, and return to Upton for your reward.

== Dialogue ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
; Namar
: ''"Alas, I am behind on my rent, and my landlord, [[Gelsan the Outfitter|Gelsan]], has run out of patience with me. I fear I will be put out of my home. I'll understand if you'd rather not help a [[Kryta]]n; our nations were at war a long time. But I'm not your enemy, and I could really use some assistance.''

: ''"My friend, '''Miller Upton''', lives to the southwest. I know he'll help me if I can get a message to him. If you're going that way, could you tell him of my plight?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Certainly. How could I refuse?
| decline = This isn't my problem.
| ask = '''Miller Upton''' lives just southwest of here, at the mill in Ashford. If you can get word to him of my trouble, I know he'll help me.
}}

=== Intermediate dialogue ===
; Miller Upton
: ''"I'm sorry, I really can't worry about helping Namar until I get rid of these damnable bees. Think you can give me a hand? Take one of the '''honeycombs''' lying on the ground and use it to lure the '''bees''' across the bridge. If you lure those three swarms of bees away, I'll be able to think straight again."''

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Miller Upton
: ''"Sorry about that. I was trying to make dough infused with honey, but all it did was attract bees. Not to worry about Namar, though. I'll see to it Gelsan gets off his back. No doubt Gelsan's trying to take advantage of Namar because he's not from [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|Ascalon]]. Once he knows there's a citizen willing to stand up for Namar, he'll back off."''

== Notes ==
* This quest introduces players to [[Bundle]] items.
* The path you take to bring the Massive Honeycomb across the bridge affects the quest getting updated.
{{bug|The bee swarms might get stuck during the quest and stop moving. The easiest way to get around this issue is to lead the bees underneath the bridge just within range of the quest marker to achieve quest completion.}}
